'''Statute OB-CPO-1198''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law covering illegal medical research. This included inquiries into [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Doctor [[Kornell Divini]] was arrested under the provisions of OB-CPO-1198 for requests made on the [[MedNet]] for information on midi-chlorians, yet he later escaped to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]].
